About Company

The company is a healthcare technology firm focused on developing data-driven solutions for the life sciences and clinical research industry.

Job Description

Role Overview
We are looking for a Finance Manager– FP&A & Strategy, to own core FP&A (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial modelling, and investor/board reporting) while directly partnering with our Tech and RCM teams to build MIS trackers and dashboards out of raw operational data — patient engagement, account status, and cohort/retention tracking - not just standard finance reports.

Key Responsibilities
1. Financial Oversight and Management:
• Establish and maintain financial control standards across all teams.
• Lead corporate financial management activities, including P&L analysis, cash flow management, forecasting, debt, and investment management.
• Conduct comprehensive financial risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies.
• Develop and refine financial models to benchmark performance and guide future decisions.
2. Audit and Quality Assurance:
• Manage and coordinate rigorous audit and quality assurance processes to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data and reporting. 
• Oversee the management of financial metadata, including customer retention, patient churn rate, and employee performance metrics.
3. Strategic Planning and Communication:
• Coordinate with RCM, Tech, Sales, Marketing and other teams. 
• Provide strategic financial guidance and advice to support corporate decision-making by creating and using MIS dashboards. 
• Effectively communicate financial insights and digital health business intricacies to stakeholders and investors.
4. Operational MIS & Data Partnership:
• Partner directly with Technology , RCM and other teams to translate raw, non-financial operational data (patient engagement logs, account status exports, EMR/CRM extracts) into structured MIS trackers and dashboards, building the tracker architecture from scratch, not just populating an existing template. 
• Design and maintain cohort-style retention and engagement trackers (e.g., month-over-month decay of engaged patients/accounts by acquisition cohort), account-status pipelines (e.g., Engaged / UTR1-3 / Ready to Welcome / Pending Clinical Review), and related operational KPI views. 
• Own the ongoing accuracy and structure of these trackers as source data formats and definitions evolve, working iteratively with Tech/RCM rather than waiting on a finalized data feed. 
• Translate operational MIS findings into finance-relevant insight — linking patient/account engagement trends back to revenue, churn, and forecasting.
5. Revenue Cycle Management and Operations:
• Guide and direct medical billing processes and revenue cycle management activities. 
• Collaborate with developers to enhance the functionality and efficiency of internal financial systems.
6. Reporting and Analysis:
• Deliver timely and accurate business reporting, financial metrics, and analysis. 
• Monitor data trends, troubleshoot issues, and develop actionable plans to address financial challenges. 
• Identify root causes of data discrepancies and implement corrective measures to ensure data integrity.
7. Process Optimization and Automation:
• Streamline financial processes and workflows to optimize key performance indicators. 
• Lead efforts to automate financial reporting and business processes, driving efficiency and accuracy. 
• Plan and monitor growth and expenditure rates to support strategic decision-making.
8. Collaboration and Innovation:
• Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation across internal and external teams. 
• Engage with business leaders and cross-functional teams to align financial goals and priorities. 
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance financial performance and operational effectiveness.
9. Investor Research & Mapping:
• Identify and evaluate potential investors (VCs, PEs, and strategic investors) aligned with B2B SaaS and healthcare technology. 
• Build and maintain a structured investor database including investment thesis, ticket size, stage focus, and portfolio companies. 
• Track comparable companies, market activity, and funding trends to inform fundraising strategy.

Skills
• Proven success in strategic financial planning, analysis, and decision-making in complex organizational environments. 
• Extensive experience in financial reporting, analysis, modelling, and audit management. 
• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of identifying trends, assessing risks, and developing innovative solutions. 
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex financial concepts to stakeholders. 
• Proficiency in financial management software and ERP systems, with experience in system implementation and optimization. 
• Strong leadership abilities, demonstrated by the ability to build and lead high-performing teams. 
• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and integrity in financial reporting and analysis.
 • Adaptability to fast-paced, dynamic environments and effective management of competing priorities.

Qualifications
• Minimum 6 years of progressive financial management experience, including 2 years in a leadership role overseeing financial operations. 
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred. 
• Professional certification such as CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), or equivalent strongly preferred. 
• Experience with B2B product or product-services start-up preferred. 
• Preferred experience in the healthcare or digital health industry.

Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

The opportunity

The Data & Insights – Tooling & Reporting team plays a critical role in providing leadership with timely, accurate, and actionable business intelligence. This role transforms complex operational data into executive-ready dashboards, reports, and strategic insights that improve portfolio visibility, strengthen governance, and support better business decisions.

What you’ll be doing

Build Executive Reporting and Dashboards

• Design and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions that provide real-time visibility into portfolio performance, strategic initiatives, financial metrics, resource utilization, risks, and business outcomes.
• Develop intuitive visualization and standardized reporting frameworks that improve executive understanding and decision-making.

Deliver Strategic Insights

• Analyze business and portfolio data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes, translating findings into concise, decision-ready insights and recommendations.
• Support executive reviews, governance forums, business reviews, and strategic planning with timely, high-quality reporting and presentations.

Automate and Optimize Reporting

• Partner with Data and Automation teams to build automated reporting pipelines, self service analytics, and scalable reporting solutions that improve speed, accuracy and operational efficiency.
• Continuously enhance reporting processes, visualization standards, and user experience.

Ensure Data Quality and Governance

• Validate data accuracy completeness, and consistency across dashboards and reports, resolving anomalies in collaboration with data owners.
• Maintain reporting standards that ensure reliable trusted, and governance-aligned executive reporting.

Partner Across Business

• Collaborate with Strategy, Finance, Operations, Product, Technology, Resource Management, and Program teams to translate business needs into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
• Support cross-functional initiatives through timely reporting, analysis, and business intelligence.

Advance Data-Driven Decision Making

• Develop analytical models, reporting capabilities, and recommendations that strengthen portfolio governance and enable faster, evidence-based executive decisions.

Stay current with modern BI tools, reporting technologies, AI-enabled analytics, and visualization best practices to continuously improve enterprise reporting.

What we want from you

• 4–7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Operations, Strategy, Portfolio Reporting, or Management Consulting within a global technology or SaaS organization.
• Bachelor’s degree in business Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
• Proven experience developing executive dashboards, scorecards, reports, and business intelligence solutions that support strategic decision-making.
• Strong expertise in Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, and modern data visualization, reporting, and analytics tools.
• Solid understanding of KPI frameworks, business performance measurement, portfolio reporting, and executive governance.
• Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar systems.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, data visualization, and storytelling skills, with exceptional attention to data quality, reporting accuracy, and executive communication.
• Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders in fast-paced, matrixed environments to deliver actionable business insights.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted reporting, predictive analytics, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar modern analytics platforms.
• Experience supporting executive leadership, enterprise transformation, strategic planning, or portfolio management initiatives; consulting experience, Agile delivery, data governance, and relevant BI certifications (e.g., Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate) are advantageous.

Beyond the Resume

• Executive Storyteller: Translates complex data into clear, decision-ready insights that drive executive action.
• Insight-Driven Analyst: Looks beyond dashboards to identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities.
• Quality-Focused: Delivers accurate, reliable, and trusted reporting with exceptional attention to detail.
• Curious Problem Solver: Challenges assumptions and uncovers deeper business insights through data.
• Continuous Improver: Continuously enhances reporting, visualization, automation, and analytical capabilities.
• Business Partner: Collaborates with stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable analytical solutions.
• Strategic Thinker: Balances analytical precision with a strong understanding of business context and outcomes.

Collaborative Learner: Embraces new technologies, analytics, and visualization techniques while fostering continuous improvement.

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.

We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.

And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions).
